Here’s a classic set‑up for a hearty baked lasagna (serves ~8–10 people). Feel free to tweak quantities or swap out items based on your taste. | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Pasta** | • Lasagna sheets – either *no‑boil* or regular pre‑cooked ones
• Optional: fresh egg noodles if you want an extra tender texture | | **Meat Sauce** | • Ground beef (½ lb per pound of pasta)
• Ground pork or Italian sausage (optional, adds depth)
• Onion, finely diced
• Garlic cloves, minced
• Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce (1–2 cans, depending on size)
• Tomato paste (for richer flavor)
• Red wine (¼ cup, optional but recommended)
• Fresh basil leaves or dried oregano & thyme
• Salt, pepper, sugar (balance acidity), red‑pepper flakes (if desired) | | **Cheese Layer** | • Ricotta cheese (about 15 oz; mix with beaten egg, parsley, salt, pepper)
• Shredded mozzarella (16–20 oz total, split into layers)
• Grated Parmesan (or Pecorino Romano) for topping | | **Optional Extras** | • Sautéed spinach or kale (adds greens)
• Mushrooms, zucchini, bell peppers (sliced thinly, sautéed first)
• Pine nuts or chopped walnuts (tossed in ricotta for crunch)
• A splash of heavy cream mixed into ricotta for richness | | **Seasoning Mix** | • Dried Italian seasoning blend (basil, oregano, rosemary, marjoram)
• Pinch of nutmeg (a touch goes well with béchamel or creamy sauces) | ### Quick Prep Steps 1. **Cook Pasta:** If using regular sheets, boil until al dente (~7 minutes); drain and lay flat on parchment paper so they don’t stick together. 2. **Make Meat Sauce:** Brown meat + onions → add garlic → pour in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, wine, herbs → simmer 30–45 min. Adjust thickness with water/stock if too thick. 3. **Prepare Cheese Mixture:** Beat ricotta with one egg, half the grated parmesan, chopped parsley, salt, pepper. Fold in any extras like spinach or pine nuts. 4. **Layer Assembly (in a baking dish):** - Spread a thin layer of meat sauce at bottom.
- Place a sheet of pasta over it.
- Spoon dollops of ricotta mixture, then sprinkle shredded mozzarella.
- Repeat layers (usually 3–4 rounds) ending with a generous top layer of mozzarella + remaining parmesan. 5. **Bake:** Cover loosely with foil (prevent sticking by spraying interior side lightly with cooking spray) → bake 25 min → remove foil → bake another 15–20 min till bubbly & golden. 6. **Rest & Serve:** Let stand 10–15 minutes before slicing to keep layers intact. Enjoy! 🍝
